name: Healthcare Data Protection Policy
description:
Thematic policy for protected health information: medical record and health-plan identifiers, provider identifiers, diagnosis and prescription data, and the national health-service numbers of every jurisdiction the catalog covers. Membership is the whole healthcare category.

PHI is deliberately its own theme rather than a slice of PII — to a compliance user "do you protect health data?" is a different question from "do you protect personal data?", and the two are governed by different regimes. Regime-specific escalation (HIPAA Safe-Harbor identifiers, UK-GDPR Article 9 special-category data) lives in the matching overlay policy, not here.

Scope: Protected health information — global, category-driven
